‘DAPAT HINDI ‘YUNG FARE HIKE ANG SINUSPINDE’

Transport group Piston president Mody Floranda said that 90 percent of major routes in Metro Manila were paralyzed during the first day of their transport strike on Thursday.

Floranda slammed the suspension of the fare hike, stressing that the excise tax and value-added tax on petroleum products should instead be removed.

“Dapat hindi ‘yung fare hike ang sinuspinde ni [President] Bongbong Marcos… dapat ay ‘yung mataas na buwis sa produktong petrolyo at ‘yung excise tax at saka ‘yung sa VAT… dahil ito ‘yung nagdudulot ng patuloy na pahirap hindi lamang sa mga driver kundi sa ating mga mamamayan,” he said.

He added that the transport strike will continue on Friday, March 20, not only in Metro Manila but also in several parts of the country. | via Josiah Antonio
